statement: No PCM/audio-sample-bearing Bluetooth report layout is established by inspected Linux hid-playstation.c or SDL_hidapi_ps5.c. Both provide Bluetooth HID output report 0x31 for effect/control bytes, but neither inspected path serializes audio frames. Linux explicitly excludes Bluetooth jack audio handling. Additional independent BT PCM research and physical traces remain required; do not interpret SDL's audio-haptics enable/disable bit as evidence of a sample stream.

applicability.scope: Searched pinned Linux hid-playstation output structures/send paths and Bluetooth audio comments, and pinned SDL PS5 HID effects send path and audio-haptics control. No external in-band waveform layout verified.
